welcome.title: Welcome to Lux!
welcome.description: Your life management system. We'll explain how everything works so you can make the most of your experience.

xp.title: Experience (XP)
xp.description: Complete tasks and habits to earn XP. Level up and unlock new abilities. Every action gives you experience points.

tp.title: TP (Training Points)
tp.description: TP measures your progress in specific skills. The more you practice an area, the more TP you earn.

gold.title: Gold Coins
gold.description: Earned by completing tasks. Use them to buy cosmetics, power-ups, and manage your habits in a controlled way.

streak.title: Streak
streak.description: Keep your daily streak by completing at least one task. If you miss a day, the streak resets.

dock.title: Navigation Dock
dock.description: Here you can switch between different sections: Tasks, Habits, Focus, Notes and more.

quest-button.title: Create Mission
quest-button.description: Press here to create a new task or mission. Each completed task gives you XP and coins.

complete.title: Ready to Begin!

xp.title: The Energy System (XP)
xp.desc1: Experience (XP) measures your overall progress. You earn XP by completing Habits, Tasks, and Focus Sessions.

tp.title: Trait Points (TP)
tp.desc1: Trait Points (TP) allow you to improve your specific attributes (Strength, Intelligence, Discipline, etc.).
tp.desc2: There are multiple Traits you can develop. You can change and manage them in the Attributes Zone to focus on what you need to improve most in your current life.
tp.tip: Assign tasks to different traits to level them up.

gold.title: The Economy (Gold)
gold.desc1: Gold is the currency of LUX, earned through daily effort and missions.
gold.point2: Pay Penalties: Use Gold when you relapse to avoid losing HP.

hp.title: Vitality (HP) and Punishments
hp.desc1: Your HP (Health Points) is your vitality. If you commit Bad Habits and decide not to use Gold to pay the penalty, you will lose HP.
hp.desc2: If your HP reaches 0, you will suffer a system failure: Your Account Level and the Levels of ALL your Attributes will be reduced by half.

tips.title: Tips in each section
tips.desc1: In several parts of the application you will find a small lightbulb. Don't hesitate to press it!
tips.buttonDesc: When pressed, it will activate a visual tour explaining exactly how the screen you are on works.

wizard.returnNoPenaltyDesc: If you fail, you go back to the previous goal. You don't lose everything, just one level.
